src: U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2021
s: The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) of NITI Aayog was launched in :
x: Launched by the PM Narendra Modi in January 2018, the Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) of NITI Aayog aims to quickly and effectively transform 112 most under-developed districts across the country. With States as the main drivers, this programme focuses on the strength of each district, identifying low-hanging fruits for immediate improvement and measuring progress by ranking districts on a monthly basis. The ranking is based on the incremental progress made across 49 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) under 5 broad socio-economic themes– Health & Nutrition, Education, Agriculture & Water Resources, Financial Inclusion & Skill Development and Infrastructure. PM Modi launched the Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP) of NITI Aayog in January, 2023, aiming to expedite the development of 500 relatively underdeveloped blocks across the country and improve socio-economic conditions in them.
